input.actions: 1) Took baseline status/logs and snapshotted server.properties at shift start. 2) Noticed stale exporter metrics, then status DOWN; found deploy note and diffed current server.properties against my snapshot and deploy/previous/server.properties: white-list and enforce-whitelist had flipped to true in addition to max-players=40. 3) Confirmed whitelist.json was empty; declared the incident. 4) While the server was mid-restart, wrote server.properties = previous config + max-players=40 (white-list=false, enforce-whitelist=false). The boot had already loaded the bad properties, so on coming up it still rejected players. 5) Ran console `whitelist off` (reply: "Whitelist is now turned off"), which fixed the live state without another restart; players began joining 2 s later. 6) The server's rewrite of server.properties on that command restored enforce-whitelist=true, so I rewrote server.properties once more with enforce-whitelist=false, white-list=false, max-players=40. 7) Verified: no whitelist rejections after 06:54:40, joins resumed from 06:54:44 (Steve_Mines, Alex_Builds, newplayer11-22), TPS 20, 2 players online, on-disk config correct. I did not stop or restart the server myself; the one restart was performed by the deploy before I intervened.
input.residual_risk: Players lost their session during the deploy's restart and were locked out for ~15 s after boot. The deploy tooling that pushed the wrong file is unchanged and could re-push a bad server.properties; the deploy note and deploy/previous/ remain as-is for the team. If anyone runs a whitelist toggle command before the next restart, Paper will rewrite server.properties from its in-memory copy (enforce-whitelist=true) — harmless while the whitelist is off, and the on-disk file I wrote will be read correctly on the next restart. The 4 end_crystal/strider etc. entities and offline-mode warnings are pre-existing and unrelated.

Shift report filed. Summary:

**Incident:** A config deploy (OPS-250, intended only to raise `max-players` 20→40) also flipped `white-list=true` and `enforce-whitelist=true` with an empty `whitelist.json`, then restarted the server. Everyone was disconnected, and on reboot every join (Alex_Builds, Steve_Mines, newplayer09/10) was rejected as "not whitelisted".

**Fix (no additional restart):** Declared the incident, rewrote `server.properties` to the previous config plus the one intended change, and ran `whitelist off` on the console to correct the live state immediately. Players reconnected within 2 seconds, and a stream of new season‑3 players joined after. Rewrote the file once more to clear a stray `enforce-whitelist=true` that Paper's command-triggered rewrite put back.

**Final state:** UP, TPS 20.0, 2 players online, all plugins enabled, config on disk matches intent. No bans, no deletions, no restarts by me.
